docstring: FLUX.1 [dev] is a powerful open-weight text-to-image model with 12 billion parameters. Optimized for prompt following and visual quality.
useCases: Generate high-quality images from text prompts
Create detailed illustrations with precise control
Generate multiple variations from one prompt
Create safe-for-work content with built-in safety checker

inputFields.name: acceleration
inputFields.description: The speed of the generation. The higher the speed, the faster the generation.

inputFields.name: prompt
inputFields.description: The prompt to generate an image from

inputFields.name: enable_safety_checker
inputFields.description: Enable safety checker to filter unsafe content

inputFields.name: sync_mode
inputFields.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

inputFields.name: num_images
inputFields.description: Number of images to generate

inputFields.name: image_size
inputFields.description: Size preset for the generated image

inputFields.name: num_inference_steps
inputFields.description: Number of denoising steps. More steps typically improve quality

inputFields.name: guidance_scale
inputFields.description: How strictly to follow the prompt. Higher values are more literal

inputFields.name: seed
inputFields.description: Seed for reproducible results. Use -1 for random

inputFields.name: output_format
inputFields.description: The format of the generated image.

outputFields.name: prompt
outputFields.description: The prompt used for generating the image.

outputFields.name: seed
outputFields.description:
Seed of the generated Image. It will be the same value of the one passed in the
            input or the randomly generated that was used in case none was passed.

outputFields.name: has_nsfw_concepts
outputFields.description: Whether the generated images contain NSFW concepts.

enums.name: Acceleration
enums.description: The speed of the generation. The higher the speed, the faster the generation.

enums.name: ImageSizePreset
enums.description: The size of the generated image.

enums.name: OutputFormat
enums.description: The format of the generated image.

docstring: Hunyuan Video is Tencent's advanced text-to-video model for high-quality video generation.
useCases: Generate cinematic videos from text descriptions
Create marketing videos from product descriptions

inputFields.name: num_frames
inputFields.description: The number of frames to generate.

inputFields.name: resolution
inputFields.description: The resolution of the video to generate.

inputFields.name: aspect_ratio
inputFields.description: The aspect ratio of the video to generate.

inputFields.name: prompt
inputFields.description: The prompt to generate the video from.

inputFields.name: enable_safety_checker
inputFields.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.

inputFields.name: pro_mode
inputFields.description: By default, generations are done with 35 steps. Pro mode does 55 steps which results in higher quality videos but will take more time and cost 2x more billing units.

inputFields.name: seed
inputFields.description: The seed to use for generating the video.

outputFields.name: seed
outputFields.description: The seed used for generating the video.

enums.description: The number of frames to generate.

enums.name: AspectRatio
